description: This Java class, TableGenerator, reads XY data from a CSV file ('in.csv') and writes a C array table representing this data, formatted for use in embedded systems or firmware.

classes.name: TableGenerator
classes.description: Main class responsible for reading XY data from CSV and outputting a formatted C array representing the data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that reads XY data from 'in.csv' and invokes the writeAsC method to generate a C file.

methods.name: writeAsC
methods.description: Public method to generate C array data from XYData, with exception handling.

methods.name: doWrite
methods.description: Core private method that writes the XYData to a C array in the specified output file, formatted with comments and multi-dimensional array syntax.

methods.name: writeArray
methods.description: Helper method to write an array definition with a count macro and the static float array.

methods.name: outputDoubles
methods.description: Helper method that writes a list of doubles as a static float array with comments indicating index.
